name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.181: The archived original is now stored exactly as SubDL delivered it. Files that
    already carried a byte-order mark were saved with a SECOND one in front, because the archive
    was decoded and re-encoded before being written; measured, 55108 bytes came back as 55111.
    Only a corrected file now goes out normalized — UTF-8, no BOM, LF — so the bytes on disk are
    the bytes the stored hash describes. A file the correction did not touch is unchanged.
